## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] The change was tested or reviewed in proportion to its risk.
- [ ] Documentation and internal links were updated.
- [ ] Architectural decisions and residual risks were recorded where required.

## Security and Sanitization

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, keys, cookies, recovery codes, or secret values are included.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, exports, paths, hostnames, addresses, identifiers, and personal data were sanitized.
- [ ] The final rendered artifacts were inspected at full resolution.
- [ ] Testing was authorized and limited to the documented scope.

## Recovery

Describe rollback or recovery steps, or explain why they are not applicable.
